idea_summary: He Was Socrates — 100% on-device Korean Socratic bust on macOS, powered by Gemma 4 E4B 4-bit MLX. Submission asset for The Gemma 4 Good Hackathon (Kaggle × Google DeepMind, deadline 2026-05-19 08:59 KST, $200K total prize pool). Two artifacts requested: (A) interactive single-file HTML preview embeddable in/linkable from the Kaggle entry page (~30–60 KB self-contained, claudedocs/preview/index.html style), and (B) a markdown patch proposal for the GitHub repo README's hero / hackathon section. Target categories (user-confirmed 2026-05-07): #1 Impact-focused / Education (primary narrative — Socratic maieutics as a Korean-language learning tool, defer_to_human as 'abstention as product' for AI safety, all dialogue on-device), #2 Technical (engineering evidence backing the impact claim — NO-CLOUD invariant + PR-Λ 24× TTFT improvement + 4-function dispatch), #3 General (auxiliary). Newly-added §3 General requirement: generate a 26-persona gallery page from the 26 Preview Forge advocates, publish it publicly to https://github.com/Two-Weeks-Team via GitHub Pages, and share the rendered gallery URL with team members.

core_value_prop: He Was Socrates makes the abstention mechanic the product: a Korean Socratic interlocutor that runs entirely on the user's Mac (zero bytes leave the device), gives back questions instead of answers, and honestly defers to humans for medical / legal / financial / emergency / welfare / insurance topics — turning AI safety from a disclaimer into a first-class product feature, evidenced by PR-Λ's 24× TTFT improvement (4.6 s → 192 ms) under a NO-CLOUD invariant.
